Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Halel Nethun: 24-year-old woman, 183 cm (tall), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: long narrow face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; prominent bridge, compact mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: dramatic contrasting side length. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
